title: SEO Metadata
description: The shared SEO block — <title>, meta description, keywords, Open Graph overrides, canonical URL and robots flags, for any content type that owns a URL (page, blog article, product). One definition per field, $ref'd individually by the consuming type, rather than a single grouped object like section-header: these fields sit at the body root, so grouping them would nest the data and is a migration of existing content, not a schema tidy-up. Per-field refs are also what lets a type override an individual title or description alongside the $ref — copy here stays type-agnostic for that reason. Consumed at property level, never via a root-level allOf: the form builder picks controls from the type's own properties and ignores root branches, which renders half the block as errors and the other half not at all.
